name: Miko Otome Sennou Choukyou
source:
Defeated demon has to live in human body in a town fully protected by barriers. Autumn ritual time approaches, so main character sneaks to the shrine maiden room while priest is away. Protagonist can't kill maidens protected by sacred ancestor blood, but he can defile these two girls and thus disqualify them for the ritual.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
被擊敗的惡魔不得不寄宿在人類體內，生活在一座被結界完全守護的城鎮中。秋季祭典的時期即將來臨，於是主角趁神主外出時潛入了巫女的房間。主角無法殺死被神聖先祖之血保護的巫女，但他可以玷汙這兩個女孩，使她們失去參加祭典的資格。

［引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]］
